questions.question: Find the average of 12, 15, 18, 21 and 24.
questions.shortcut: The numbers are evenly spaced, so the average is the middle number, 18.

questions.explanation: Sum = Average × Count = 40 × 5 = 200.

The average of the first five even numbers is
questions.explanation: The numbers are 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 with sum 30. Average = 30 ÷ 5 = 6.
questions.shortcut: First n even numbers have average n + 1 = 6.

questions.question: A student scored 70, 80 and 90 in three tests. The average score is
questions.explanation: Sum = 240. Average = 240 ÷ 3 = 80.

questions.question: The average age of 10 students is 15 years. When the teacher's age is included the average becomes 16. The teacher's age is
questions.explanation: Students' total = 150. Total with teacher = 11 × 16 = 176. Teacher = 176 − 150 = 26.

questions.question: The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one number is removed, the average of the remaining numbers becomes 25. The removed number is
questions.explanation: Total of 5 = 135. Total of 4 = 100. Removed number = 135 − 100 = 35.

questions.question: The average of 6 numbers is 20. If every number is multiplied by 3, the new average is
questions.explanation: Multiplying every number by 3 multiplies the average by 3. New average = 20 × 3 = 60.

questions.question: A batsman's average after 15 innings is 32. He scores 48 in the 16th innings. His new average is
questions.explanation: Total after 15 = 480. Total after 16 = 528. New average = 528 ÷ 16 = 33.

questions.question: The average of the first 20 odd numbers is
questions.explanation: The sum of the first n odd numbers is n² = 400. Average = 400 ÷ 20 = 20.

questions.question: A car goes from A to B at 60 km/h and returns at 40 km/h along the same road. The average speed for the round trip is
questions.explanation: For equal distances, average speed = 2 × 60 × 40 ÷ (60 + 40) = 4800 ÷ 100 = 48 km/h.

questions.question: Class A has 30 students with average mark 60 and Class B has 20 students with average mark 70. The average of all 50 students is
The average of 7 consecutive numbers is 20. The largest of them is
questions.explanation: For consecutive numbers the average is the middle one, so the numbers are 17 to 23. The largest is 23.

questions.question: The average of 11 results is 50. The average of the first six is 49 and of the last six is 52. The sixth result is
questions.explanation: Total of 11 = 550. First six total = 294, last six total = 312. The sixth is counted twice in 294 + 312 = 606, so it is 606 − 550 = 56.

questions.question: The average weight of 8 persons increases by 2.5 kg when a new person replaces one of them weighing 65 kg. The weight of the new person is
questions.explanation: Total weight rises by 8 × 2.5 = 20 kg. New person = 65 + 20 = 85 kg.
questions.shortcut: Difference = change in average × group size.

questions.question: The average of 9 numbers is 30. The average of the first five is 25 and of the last five is 34. The fifth number is
questions.explanation: Total of 9 = 270. First five = 125, last five = 170, together 295. The fifth is counted twice, so it is 295 − 270 = 25.

Five years ago the average age of a husband and wife was 23. Now, with a child, the average age of the family of three is 20. The child's present age is
questions.explanation: Present total age of the couple = 2 × 23 + 2 × 5 = 56. Family total = 3 × 20 = 60. Child = 60 − 56 = 4 years.

questions.question: The average of 30 numbers is 25. If two numbers 18 and 22 are replaced by 52 and 48, the new average is
questions.explanation: The sum of the replaced numbers rises from 40 to 100, an increase of 60. The average rises by 60 ÷ 30 = 2, so it becomes 27.
